title: PriorArtSkeptic
requirements: Implement the P10 Skeptic stage after cross-domain evidence and before the P10-T09 verdict engine.
Preserve the allowed PriorArtVerdict boundary and never infer PROVEN_NEW from absence of evidence.
Keep the component deterministic, evidence-bound, provider-free and compatible with the T07 handoff guard.

contract.output: PriorArtSkepticReport: JSON-safe Mapping with adversarial-pass fields and a non-final process verdict.

decisions: The skeptic is an evidence-coverage adversary, not a similarity, novelty or final-verdict engine.
PriorArtSkepticReport implements Mapping so the real P10-T07 guard can consume it without a duplicate handoff model.
Source error text is not copied into gaps or reports; only source identity and controlled error category are retained.
Coverage gaps force requires_experiment. Formal coverage permits only survives_with_conditions and never a PriorArtVerdict.
evidence: Source failure, empty success, missing provenance, malformed document and mapping mismatch are covered by focused tests.
The integration test executes CrossDomainScout -> PriorArtSkeptic -> validate_downstream_handoff with injected transports and no network.
The full CRIBA regression passed after the final code change.
limitations: The skeptic does not decide whether a document materially overlaps a candidate mechanism; P10-T09 owns that decision.
survives_with_conditions is a Skeptic process state, not SURVIVED_SEARCH.
P10-T07 remains PARTIAL until P10-T09 consumes the real Skeptic report and the full handoff is exercised.
No external source probe was run in this task; all verification used injected transports at COST=0.
commit_reason: No commit was created: the shared CRIBA worktree already contains P10-T07 and unrelated pre-existing dirty changes; staging the modified package export or global state would mix incomplete T07 work with this task.
cost: COST=0; no paid service, provider, credential or external source call was used.
rollback: Preserve the shared dirty tree. P10-T08-specific additions are skeptic.py, test_prior_art_skeptic.py, ADR-P10-T08-prior-art-skeptic-contract.md and this journal. The P10-T08 import and __all__ entries in prior_art/__init__.py must be removed only by a reviewed line-level revert because that file also contains pre-existing P10-T07 work.
follow_up: Implement P10-T09 as a separate verdict-engine task consuming PriorArtSkepticReport and SourceQueryResult without treating absence as PROVEN_NEW.
Then exercise the complete CrossDomainScout -> Skeptic -> verdict path and reassess P10-T07 closure.
Do not introduce external probes, providers, semantic similarity, mutations or flags under the P10-T08 scope.
